description: Reads three gates as a binary number and raises one of eight outputs to 10V

inputs.text: The one of the number, adding 1 while it reads above 0V
The two of the number, adding 2 while it reads above 0V
The four of the number, adding 4 while it reads above 0V

outputs.text: Carries 10V while the three inputs decode to its own number, counted from the top starting at zero, and 0V otherwise

notes: with nothing patched the number decoded is zero, so the first output carries 10V as soon as the module is placed

inputs.0:
high above 0V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
